purpose: Separate observability of Romania's fiscal accounting components from identification of a stable primary-balance reaction function.
current_registry_form: Delta primary_balance = f(debt_gap, output_gap, institutional/fiscal-package regime)

net_lending_borrowing.concept: General-government net lending (+) / net borrowing (-), Romania, quarterly
net_lending_borrowing.adjustment: calendar and seasonally adjusted for the exact example key
net_lending_borrowing.semantic_note: B9 equals revenue minus expenditure and therefore includes interest expenditure.

primary_balance_measurement_boundary.accounting_identity: primary_balance = net_lending_borrowing + interest_expenditure, when both components share a compatible accounting/unit/seasonal boundary and interest expenditure is expressed as a positive use.
primary_balance_measurement_boundary.blocker: The retained D41PAY snapshot is non-seasonally adjusted while the exact B9 key currently used elsewhere is seasonally adjusted; do not add mismatched variants.
primary_balance_measurement_boundary.admissible_next_step: Preregister one adjustment/unit boundary and materialise matched B9 and D41PAY on that same boundary before computing primary balance.

output_gap_boundary.rule: Do not treat real GDP growth, unemployment, or deviation from a deterministic trend as an output gap without a separately preregistered measurement method.
output_gap_boundary.implication: A fiscal reaction coefficient on an estimated output gap inherits measurement-model uncertainty and does not become structurally identified merely because fiscal accounts are observed.

required_examples: Excessive Deficit Procedure / fiscal-governance regime status
major discretionary tax or expenditure packages
one-off capital transfers or exceptional measures where material
regime_boundary.rule: Regime indicators must be coded from dated institutional/policy evidence before coefficient estimation. Do not infer breaks from residuals and then treat them as exogenous.

reasons: A matched quarterly primary-balance series has not yet been materialised on one seasonal/unit boundary.
The output gap is not directly observed and no measurement model is frozen.
Institutional/fiscal-package regimes are not encoded ex ante.
The registered debt_gap concept is not frozen; observed debt-to-GDP is not automatically a debt gap.
source_admissibility.rule: Observed debt and fiscal balances do not authorize a stable Taylor-style fiscal rule. Estimation requires a new preregistered regime-aware candidate family and independent validation.

prohibited_shortcuts: Add seasonally adjusted B9 to non-seasonally adjusted D41PAY.
Treat observed debt-to-GDP as a debt gap without a target/reference definition.
Use GDP growth as output gap by relabelling.
Estimate break dates from the same residuals used to fit the fiscal reaction and call the breaks exogenous regimes.
Ignore discretionary fiscal packages or EDP/institutional changes to obtain a stable coefficient.
Activate the government refinancing-interest loop from a fiscal regression.
